CHAPTER 10: GEOTHERMAL RESOURCES AND DEVELOPMENT

Ordinance Section 10-1: Purpose and Intent
This chapter establishes regulations for geothermal resource development in the county
to ensure safe, sustainable, and environmentally responsible extraction and use of
geothermal energy resources.

Ordinance Section 10-2: Definitions
Geothermal well: A well drilled for the purpose of extracting geothermal energy.
Geothermal development: Any activity related to exploration, production, or use of
geothermal resources.
Geothermal permit: Authorization required for geothermal development activities.

Ordinance Section 10-3: Geothermal Exploration Permits
(a) Any person proposing geothermal exploration activities shall obtain a geothermal
    exploration permit from the county.
(b) The application shall demonstrate environmental impact assessment and community
    notification procedures.
(c) Geothermal permits shall be valid for one year from issuance.

Ordinance Section 10-4: Operating Procedures
Operators must comply with all state and federal geothermal regulations. Regular
monitoring of geothermal systems is required.
